guide.title: Replace Diaphragm on Sample Pump
guide.description: Replace the worn diaphragm on the ACME SP-928 sample pump.
guide.author: GuideOS Team

phases.title: Preparation
phases.description: Isolate and prepare the pump for service.

steps.title: Isolate the pump
steps.instruction: Lock out and tag out power. Close the inlet valve and bleed pressure below {pressure1}.
warnings: Verify electrical isolation with a meter before continuing.

steps.title: Drain process fluid
steps.instruction: Open drain valve and collect process fluid in an approved container.

phases.title: Diaphragm Replacement
phases.description: Remove and replace the diaphragm assembly.

steps.title: Remove pump head
steps.instruction: Using {tool1}, remove the 6 head bolts in a star pattern.

steps.title: Install new diaphragm
steps.instruction: Install {part1} and torque head bolts to {torque1} in a star pattern. Apply {chemical1} to bolt threads.

steps.title: Restore service
steps.instruction: Remove lockout, open inlet valve, restore power and verify pump pressure reaches {pressure1}.
